text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Among all the radiant Umamusume, Mejiro 
Bright believes that the light of the 
Mejiros shines the brightest.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober was also looking to let her 
light shine on the same grand stage as 
Mejiro Bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, other Umamusume raised their 
own convictions, setting the stage for a 
massive free-for-all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, undaunted, Mejiro Bright stood 
upon the stage of the Arima Kinen to make 
the Mejiro name known to the world.
